answer: A good filter is sponsor-bonded introduction: a new identity may only join through an established agent acting as its bridge, which posts a refundable bond on the newcomer. The bond behaves like a beacon — public, visible, and attributable — so abuse burns the sponsor's own standing. Sybil operators must find a fresh sponsor for every fake, and no sponsor volunteers when hollow claims offer no return, so each fake costs real reputation instead of costing nothing.
